scope: Read-only asset metadata/index and pinned official runtime-source evidence for the existing fixed Qwen27B FP8 v1; no model download, GPU run, source edit or query-gold read for this record.

fixed_asset.conclusion: The fixed v1 asset declares and indexes an MTP head, rather than only advertising MTP in config. Numerical tensor contents and official/repacked tensor-byte identity were not revalidated here.

fixed_runtime.publisher_check_limitation: Publisher metadata is supporting provenance, not our runtime acceptance/throughput measurement.

findings: SpeculativeConfig accepts method=mtp and the legacy qwen3_5_mtp alias; the legacy alias is normalized to mtp.
For method=mtp without a separate draft model, reuse the target model path and target quantization.
Qwen3.5 text/conditional configs are mapped to qwen3_5_mtp and Qwen3_5MTP using mtp_num_hidden_layers.
More than one speculative token reuses the same MTP layer; source warns that acceptance may decrease. K=2 is not a promised speedup.
Use standard rejection verification, not synthetic acceptance settings.
Qwen3_5MTP is registered to the qwen3_5_mtp module.
Qwen3_5MTP loads mtp.* checkpoint weights through its MTP model namespace.
Constructor raises NotImplementedError when mamba_cache_mode=all and explicitly asks for --mamba-cache-mode=align.
Documents the --speculative-config JSON syntax using method=mtp and num_speculative_tokens.

fixed_runtime.conclusion: The exact pinned runtime has a Qwen3.5 MTP implementation and configuration path. Code support alone does not establish acceleration on L4x4 or successful long-context decoding.

direct_context_budget.bound_provenance: Known six-task prompt bound supplied by root; actual direct request prompt_tokens should still be recorded from server usage.
direct_context_budget.note: 49152 total generated tokens already includes up to 40960 thinking tokens; do not add thinking a second time. The selected six prompts fit below 65536 at the known <=10.6K bound. This is not a guarantee for all 240 tasks: use actual rendered/tokenized prompt lengths, retain formatting/special-token overhead, and reduce the generation cap or handle oversized tasks before applying this setting to the full set.
